prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I understand you need it. I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was on a two-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, going through a light stretch with a shallow curve. Traffic was moving slowly.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was driving straight, maybe twenty-five miles an hour. The other car came over into my lane. I hit the brakes and turned a little, but there wasn't enough room.

Q: Was there a head-on contact?

A: Yes, front to front, but it wasn't a hard hit. The airbags didn't go off. It felt more like a jolt than a crash.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?

A: I got out, but my right knee was throbbing and I had trouble putting weight on it. I sat on the curb until the paramedics came.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, they took me by ambulance to the emergency room. They X-rayed the knee and gave me a brace and crutches. I was told to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you had any follow-up appointments since then?

A: I've seen the orthopedist twice. They mentioned possible ligament strain and ordered an MRI. I'm still in physical therapy a few times a week.

Q: Do you have any pre-existing problems with that knee?

A: I had some stiffness years ago from playing soccer, but nothing that stopped me from working or driving. It was mostly fine before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm still having pain going up stairs, and I've missed some work because of it. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
